title: Count Letters, Digits, Spaces, and Special Characters
statement: Given a string text, return how many letters, digits, spaces, and special characters it contains.
think: What is the task asking? Count characters in four categories.
What is the key operation? Inspect each character and classify it.
What wording signals stand out? Count, letters, digits, spaces, special characters.
What is the brute force idea? Separate passes per category.
What is the better/optimal idea? One pass and update one of four counters.
What are the edge cases? Empty string, all spaces, symbols only.
What is the complexity? O(n) time and O(1) space.
How would I explain it in an interview? I classify each character once using char helper methods.
interview: I would use a single pass and classify each character into exactly one category: letter, digit, whitespace, or special character.
ru: Это задача на классификацию символов. За один проход распределяем каждый символ в одну из четырёх групп.

critical: Mix up space and special character counts

gaps: Important: confidence with char helper methods
Nice to have: explain mutually exclusive conditions
constraints: Assume text may contain printable characters.
whyThisPattern: This is a Linear Scan because the solution is a one-pass character classification problem.
whyNotOtherPatterns: Not Dictionary, because no per-value map is needed.
Not Two Pointers, because there is no pairwise comparison.
